study: ethane/LTA histogram-estimator replication + 350 K extension + matched sham

sampler._budget_note: identical force-evaluation budget at every T; if ABF cannot converge at low T within it, that IS the starved regime -- censoring is reported, never imputed
sampler._: identical to configs/uniform_campaign/lta_sweep_prereg.json except abf_estimator; abf_bandwidth is unused by the histogram branch and kept only so the field set is the sweep's; the FR marginal KDE (kde_bandwidth, object B), rate, cadence, start, clip and cap are untouched

replication_rules_raw.fr_effect_within_estimator: paired by seed: Delta = (arm - abf)/abf for I_F and e_F(T); median, bootstrap 95 % CI (10000, seed 20260829), wins
replication_rules_raw.replicates: (i) same sign of median Delta I_F and Delta e_F(T) as the kernel sweep at that T; (ii) if the kernel CI95 upper bound for Delta I_F < 0 then the histogram's is too; (iii) |median Delta I_F(hist) - median Delta I_F(kernel)| <= 10 points OR overlapping CIs; same for Delta e_F(T) with 15 points
replication_rules_raw.absolute_accuracy_acceptable: histogram ABF own median e_F(T) within +25 % of kernel ABF's (legacy read-out, recomputed with the same code), and median I_F within +25 %; better is not a failure
replication_rules_raw.safety: the sweep's genealogy floors: median across seeds of per-seed min ESS/N >= 0.30 and max lineage share <= 0.05 (worst seed reported)

predictions.P1_replication: histogram FR vs histogram ABF at 300 / 150 / 225 / 80 K has the same sign and a magnitude within 10 points of the kernel sweep (-14.8 / -31.9 / -21.3 / -35.1 % integrated; -19.7 / -56.3 / -28.2 / -74.7 % final), 16/16 or 15/16 wins; CIs exclude zero
predictions.P2_baseline: histogram ABF own e_F(T) is within +-10 % of kernel ABF's legacy read-out (0.087 / 0.134 / 0.095 / 0.164 kJ/mol): the read-out audit put raw bins on the plateau, so the online own-bin bias costs little; I_F within +15 %
predictions.P3_350K: benefit keeps shrinking: Delta I_F between -12 % and 0 (ABF crossings per replica > 2.7), final within +-10 %, verdict NEUTRAL or a marginal ACCELERATION_POSITIVE; the reference's entropic share rises above 72 %. If instead Delta I_F < -15 % at 350 K the entropy-share reading gains support and the starvation reading loses -- recorded as the alternative
predictions.P4_sham: the matched sham is NEUTRAL to slightly harmful vs ABF (|Delta I_F| < 5 %, final +0..+10 %) at every T; FR beats its sham directly by at least two thirds of its FR-vs-ABF margin, CI excluding zero (gateway precedent: -11.8 % direct when -12.1 % vs ABF)
predictions.P5_screening_rule: the proposed rule already classifies 150-300 K as establishment-limited on the kernel ABF arms (T_hit/T_run 0.03-0.05, T_est/T_run 0.6-0.7) and the histogram arms will agree; the e0/8 convention (tau 2.4-4.2) does NOT -- i.e. the rule works only with a threshold tied to the FINAL error, not to the initial one
predictions.P6_health: histogram FR fires more replacement events than the kernel FR (+30-70 %, the WCA precedent) and its median min ESS/N stays >= 0.30 at 150-350 K; 80 K may again fall below (0.257 under the kernel)

conventions.health: median across seeds of per-seed min ESS/N and max lineage share over FR-active saves; worst seed alongside
conventions.p0_floor: periodic CubicSpline of the reference F -> exact bin-average force -> histogram_pmf -> aligned RMS at the cell centres

P3_350K.reading: Delta I_F in [-12, 0], |Delta e_F(T)| <= 10, verdict NEUTRAL or ACCELERATION_POSITIVE; the alternative reading if Delta I_F < -15

P4_sham.reading: sham |Delta I_F| < 5 and final in [0, +10]; direct FR-vs-sham Delta I_F <= 2/3 of FR-vs-ABF with CI upper < 0

P6_health.reading: hist FR events +30-70 % vs kernel FR; median min ESS/N >= 0.30 at T >= 150 K (80 K reported, not scored)
